verification.address: http://localhost:<this tree's port, which node frontend/apps/web/vite/worktreePort.ts prints>
verification.lookAt: The game at that address in Adam's own browser, with the debug panel open for whatever the change reports
verification.standIns: A test, a still from world:scenery or world:paint, or a number, when the change is in the offline renderer, a build rule or a document

regenerate.when: The step changed the master (world/master/terrain.png), world/palette.json, world/render.json, world/painterly.json, world/biomes.json, world/names/, world/cultures.json, or any tool or code the tiles, the paint or the maps go through; or this tree has no world cut yet
regenerate.run: The regenerate-world skill: npm run world:ready --prefix frontend, then the stills it names, then say what moved with a number and a picture

architecture.question: /admin/inspect-architecture, the page that draws how the world is set up and what the running game is made of; its source is frontend/apps/web/src/admin/architecture/
architecture.askWhen: A new running piece (a server, a store, a database, a queue, a connection between them), a new tool that bakes the world, a new kind of file it writes, a new part of the game that reads one, or a part that changed what it is responsible for. Not a fix, a pane, a mechanic inside the server or a document
